exposure: type 1 diabetes-related autoimmune antibodies (IAA, ICA, IA-2A, GADA)
cohort: 1843 women receiving universal screening for gestational diabetes mellitus with a 75 g oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT)
finding: At 4.6 years postpartum, five out of 12 women were glucose intolerant but only two still had T1D-related autoantibodies.
